articles.title: Cisco (CSCO) Unveils Sovereign And AI Infrastructure Offerings
articles.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS:CSCO) launched a Sovereign Critical Infrastructure portfolio in Canada, targeting sectors that require national control of data and networks. The company expanded its Secure AI Factory through partnerships with NVIDIA and Supermicro to support liquid cooled, high density AI infrastructure.
